entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Disable in-process parallel test execution #54967
  • `dotnetup dotnet` swallows `--help` argument instead of passing it to `dotnet` #54962
  • dotnetup crashes with malformed global.json in the current directory #54961
  • Flaky test: Nuget_reference_compat fails with ArgumentException "Destination is too short" #54960
  • Consider changing MSTest parallelization from MethodLevel to ClassLevel #54956
  • .NET 10 dotnet pack chokes on output folder named dotnet #54953

Closed

  • Some Helix work items are failing with exit code 8 (zero tests run) when all tests skipped. #54963
  • dotnetup crashes without ICU libs on Linux, but the requirement is not documented anywhere #54508
  • MTPHelpSnapshotTests.VerifyMTPHelpOutput snapshot mismatch (--progress option added) #54948
  • `dotnet test` (MTP) hangs instead of failing when the test app never handshakes — macOS CI timeout #54580

PullRequests

Created

  • Upgrade gh-aw to v0.79.8 and isolate PAT pool into copilot-pat-pool environment #54969
  • Add dotnetup local SDK setup #54968
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #54966
  • [DRAFT] Consume Microsoft.Testing.Platform.Internal.DotnetTest source package #54959
  • File-based apps: avoid evicting virtual project from cache #54958
    Area-run-file
  • Default MSTest parallelization to class level #54957
  • Stabilize flaky dotnet-watch tests (DeleteSubfolder, ServerAndResources) #54955

Merged

  • Ignore MTP exit code 8 (zero tests ran) for Helix work items #54965
  • Fix potential assembly mismatches for Microsoft.TestPlatform.ObjectModel #54952
  • Restore [CombinatorialData] in dotnet-watch.Tests using Combinatorial.MSTest #54944
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #54788
    Area-AspNetCore, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Disable failing Mark-of-the-Web test and fix parallel test failures #54945
  • Restore [CombinatorialData] in Microsoft.Extensions.DotNetDeltaApplier.Tests #54730
  • Update MTPHelpSnapshotTests snapshot for --progress option changes #54950
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 3006242 #54695
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #54484
  • Fix main build break: convert ToolPackageInstanceTests to MSTest (#54822) #54954

Updated

  • Port first-run experience to the NativeAOT CLI entrypoint #54970
  • Code review skill #54924
  • Fix incremental build/publish test flakiness by isolating NuGet cache #54870
  • Enable binlog capture for BuildWithComponents31 test #54863
  • fix: guard OSArchitecture access against PropertyNotFoundException under strict mode #54684
  • Disable in-process parallel test execution #54943
  • Enable 'dotnet sdk check' command in AOT native binary #54391
    Area-CLI
  • Allow `dotnetup` to handle when a release has no archives but has sys installers #54910
  • CLI --self-contained description is wrong #51088
  • File-based apps: recognize more logger arguments #54637
    Area-run-file
  • POC: Time-based Helix test scheduling with AzDO history #54939
  • Run NativeAOT CLI tests in CI (win-x64, linux-x64, osx-arm64) #54719
  • Honor @(RuntimeEnvironmentVariable) item changes when launching the app #54922
  • Update GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles task to generate Hot Reload runtime options #53715
  • add missing CLI projects to cli slnf file #54138
    Area-Infrastructure
  • make sure we get all the dgml files #54875
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-dotnet AOT
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54871
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.4xx' #54872
  • Migrate TemplateEngine test projects to MSTest.Sdk on MTP #54883
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Enable hot reloading for Blazor inside an iframe #53297
    backport
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54679
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54762
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetsDevelopmentManifest #54836
